classifications.rationale: The President states a general policy and governmental interest but directs no identified official to take a concrete action and creates no legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: It is the policy of the United States to maximize the stewardship of our national wealth for the sole benefit of American citizens.

classifications.rationale: The Treasury and Commerce Secretaries must develop and submit a plan within 90 days; this is an internal planning and reporting assignment, and any legal consequence would require later action.
classifications.evidence: shall develop a plan for the establishment of a sovereign wealth fund
